The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC), Ajmer has released a provisional list of candidates for eligibility checking under the Pradhyapak evam Coach (School Education) Competitive Exam 2025, for the subject Pradhyapak - History. This notice, dated 11-08-2026, follows the Objective Type written examination held on 31-05-2026 (Paper I) and 01-06-2026 (Paper II). A total of 611 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted for document verification against the advertised posts. This list is not a final selection or merit list - it only identifies candidates who need to complete document verification before RPSC issues the final result. Below is a complete, point-by-point breakdown of the important dates, cut off marks, application process, and instructions from the official notice.

DIrect Link to Check RPSC 1st Grade Result 2026 (History)

What Is This Provisional List?

RPSC has released a Provisional List of Candidates for Eligibility Checking for the post of Pradhyapak - History under the Pradhyapak evam Coach (School Education) Competitive Exam 2025. This list includes candidates who appeared in the Objective Type written examination (Paper I and Paper II) held on 31-05-2026 and 01-06-2026.

The notification is explicit that this list is prepared only for the purpose of document verification against the advertised posts. It is not a selection list or a merit/preference list. The final list of successful candidates (result) will be issued by RPSC only after the concerned department (Directorate, Secondary Education Department) completes document verification.

RPSC Pradhyapak History Provisional List: How to Check Your Roll Number

A total of 611 candidates have been provisionally included in this eligibility list. Roll numbers marked with (P) in the official notice carry a "Provisional" annotation, as clarified in the footnotes.

Because the full roll number list is long, candidates should refer directly to the official RPSC notification (PDF) dated 11-08-2026 to check whether their roll number is included. Search for your roll number within the official document, or use the "Find" (Ctrl+F) function while viewing the official PDF on the RPSC website.

Important Notes From the Official Notice

  • "P" means Provisional.
  • "ALL" means all candidates who obtained the minimum qualifying marks as per service rules were included.
  • "N.A." means no candidates were available in that category/sub-category due to the minimum qualifying marks criteria as per service rules.
  • As per Point No. 5 of the special instructions on the OMR answer sheet mentioned in the detailed advertisement dated 17-07-2025, candidates who left more than 10% of questions unanswered (did not fill any of the 5 options for those questions) have been declared ineligible for this examination. A total of 140 candidates have been declared ineligible on this basis, and their roll numbers are published separately on the RPSC website.

Required Documents for Verification

The official notice specifies that candidates must appear with all original documents and self-attested photocopies at the date, time, and venue intimated by the concerned department (Directorate, Secondary Education Department). A specific itemized list of documents (e.g., mark sheets, category certificates, ID proof) is not mentioned in this notice. Candidates should watch for a separate communication from the Secondary Education Department for the exact document checklist.

How to Apply: Filling the Detailed Application Form (Detailed Form Cum Scrutiny)

All candidates provisionally included in this list must fill an online detailed application form. Here is the process as described in the official notice:

  1. Log in to the recruitment portal using your SSO ID.
  2. Navigate to My Recruitment → Detailed Form Cum Scrutiny → Apply Now.
  3. Fill in your detailed application form online completely and accurately.
  4. The link to fill this form will be active from 16-08-2026 to 22-08-2026 (till 11:59 PM).
  5. After submitting the form, use the print option to take two printed copies of the complete detailed application form and keep them safely.
  6. Report for document verification with both printed copies, all original documents, and self-attested copies, at the date, time, and place that will be notified by the concerned department (Directorate, Secondary Education Department).

The notice clarifies that scrutiny of the detailed application form and documents will be carried out by the concerned department (Directorate, Secondary Education Department) - not directly by RPSC.

Important Instructions

  • This provisional list has been prepared solely for document verification purposes and is not a selection list or a merit/preference list.
  • The final list of successful candidates (result) will be issued by RPSC only after the concerned department completes document verification and sends the list of eligible candidates back to the Commission.
  • Candidates who do not appear for document verification on the date fixed by the department will be treated as ineligible and will not be considered in the result.
  • Eligibility of candidates will be checked strictly as per the terms and conditions/rules mentioned in the advertisement. Candidates who do not fulfil all eligibility conditions as per the rules will have their eligibility cancelled.
  • After document verification, the department will send the list of eligible candidates to RPSC. RPSC will then issue the result and recommend the names of selected candidates to the concerned department for appointment.
  • RPSC will not send any separate individual intimation to candidates regarding document verification - the concerned department will inform candidates through the appropriate medium.

The Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has released the list of candidates for the post of Research Assistant under the Finance (Budget) Department, advertised vide Advertisement No. 28/2025. The list carries each candidate's Sl. No., Application ID, Name, Father's Name and Roll Number, and has been issued under the signature of the Deputy Secretary, APSC. This article explains what the list contains, how to check your name and roll number, and what candidates should do next.

Direct Link to Check APSC Research Assistant Result 2026

APSC Research Assistant Candidate List 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Conducting Body Assam Public Service Commission (APSC)
Post Name Research Assistant
Department Finance (Budget) Department
Advertisement No. 28/2025
Document Type List of candidates (as titled in the official PDF)
Total Candidates Listed 1,379
Roll Number Range 10001 to 11379
Commission Address Jawaharnagar, Khanapara, Guwahati – 781022
Official Website apsc.nic.in

How to Check Your Name in the APSC Research Assistant List

  1. Open the official candidate list PDF (link in the Important Links section below).
  2. The list is arranged alphabetically by candidate name, from Sl. No. 1 to 1364, followed by five additional entries (Sl. No. 1375–1379) listed separately at the end.
  3. Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F on Mac) in the PDF viewer and search your name, Application ID, or Roll Number.
  4. Cross-check your Father's Name and Roll Number against your original application to confirm the match, since several candidates share the same or similar names in the list.

About the Candidate List

The list spans 30 pages and includes candidates with Roll Numbers 10001 through 11374 in alphabetical order, followed by five candidates (Roll Numbers 11375–11379) appended after the alphabetical sequence: Lucky Sharma, Nagendra Kumar Sharma, Nitish Pegu, Souradeep Dey, and Subroti Deb. The document does not explain why these five names appear outside the alphabetical run; candidates in this range may wish to verify their status directly with APSC.

Each entry in the list includes four fields:

  • Sl. No. – Serial number in the list
  • Application ID – The unique ID generated at the time of online application (format: DRAPP...)
  • Candidate's Name
  • Father's Name
  • Roll No. – Allotted roll number (10001–11379)

Also Read: BPSSC ASI Operation Result 2026

What Should Candidates Do Next?

  • Confirm the list's purpose: Check the APSC website or the advertisement corrigendum for Advt. No. 28/2025 to see whether this list is for an examination, interview, or another stage.
  • Verify your details: Make sure your name, father's name, and roll number match your original application exactly. Report discrepancies to APSC through the official contact channels.
  • Watch for further notices: Keep checking apsc.nic.in for admit cards, exam dates, or interview call letters linked to this roll number series.
  • Keep documents ready: If your roll number appears in the list, keep your original certificates, ID proof, and application acknowledgment ready in case document verification or an interview call follows.

The High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Amaravati, has notified the list of eligible and ineligible applications for the post of Law Clerk (on contract basis), along with the schedule for the viva voce (interview), to be held from 17.08.2026 to 21.08.2026. This article summarizes the key details from the official notification and the earlier AP High Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026 notice, based on verified official sources.

Direct Link to Check AP High Court Law Clerk Result 2026

AP High Court Law Clerk Result 2026 - Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body High Court of Andhra Pradesh, Amaravati
Post Name Law Clerk (Contract Basis)
Latest Update List of eligible & ineligible applications notified; viva voce schedule announced
Viva Voce Schedule 17.08.2026 to 21.08.2026

Event Date
Viva Voce Schedule 17.08.2026 to 21.08.2026

Eligibility Criteria

Criterion Requirement
Educational Qualification Degree in Law (LLB) from a recognized university either a 5-year integrated law course after 10+2, or a 3-year law degree after graduation
Recency of Degree Degree should have been passed within 2 years before the notification date, and the candidate should not be pursuing any other regular course
Age Limit Must not have attained 30 years of age as on the prescribed reference date mentioned in the notification
Nationality Must be an Indian citizen
Practising Advocates If enrolled as an Advocate, must suspend legal practice before joining and keep it suspended throughout the tenure

Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of Applications: Applications are screened for eligibility, leading to the eligible/ineligible list now notified.
  • Viva Voce: Eligible candidates appear for a viva voce (interview) at Amaravati; no written examination is conducted for this post.
  • Final Selection: Selection is made on merit by the Hon'ble Chief Justice through a committee nominated for the purpose, and the final list is subject to the Chief Justice's approval.

Candidates appearing for the viva voce bear their own travel and other expenses. The High Court may conduct the viva voce physically or through online mode depending on prevailing circumstances, as per the original notification.

Also Read: RSSB Basic & Senior Computer Instructor City Intimation Slip 2026

Important Instructions

  • Only candidates listed as eligible need to appear for the viva voce during 17.08.2026 to 21.08.2026.
  • Carry all original certificates and identity proof to the viva voce (specific list to be confirmed from the official notification/call letter).
  • Candidates appearing for the viva voce will bear their own expenses.
  • This is a contract appointment; the initial tenure is normally one year and may be extended based on performance and approval.
  • The prescribed dress code mentioned in the original notification is black trousers with a white shirt and black coat.
  • For any discrepancy in eligibility status or missing details, candidates should contact the Registrar (Recruitment), High Court of Andhra Pradesh, directly rather than relying on third-party sources.

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Local Bank Officer (LBO) online written examination held on 4 January 2026. The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

Direct Link to Check PNB LBO Score Card 2026

Particulars Details
Organization Punjab National Bank (PNB)
Post Name Local Bank Officer (LBO), Scale I / JMGS-I

Online Written Exam Date 4 January 2026

Scorecard Download Window Closes 31 August 2026, 11:55 PM

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

Documents Required at the Time of Document Verification / Joining

  • Printed copy of the PNB LBO Score Card 2026
  • Final Result / Provisional Selection intimation
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Also Read: UPSSSC VDO Supplementary Result 2026

Important Instructions

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.
  • Use your registration number rather than your name to search for your record, since candidate names can repeat.
  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.
  • Keep your scorecard along with your final result document for document verification and joining formalities.

Under the J&K region, major district-wise allocations included Srinagar (75), Jammu (75), Baramulla (35), Anantnag (30), and Budgam (30), among other districts. The Rest of India (ROI) vacancies were allocated to clusters including Delhi, Mumbai, Lucknow, Bangalore, and Mohali.

Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection for JK Bank Apprentice 2026 is based on an online written examination followed by document verification. There is no interview stage.

Section Questions Marks Duration
General Awareness & English 50 50 30 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning 50 50 30 minutes
Total 100 100 60 minutes
  • Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer.
  • No penalty for unattempted questions.
  • The merit list is prepared district-wise and category-wise.
  • A waitlist of 50% of the notified vacancies is maintained for one year from the result date or until the next recruitment exercise, whichever is earlier.

Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend structured as follows:

  • ₹13,500 per month total (₹9,000 from the Bank + ₹4,500 from the Government via DBT)
  • An additional conveyance allowance of ₹1,250
  • No other allowances are provided

  • Cross-check your name, roll number, and category details on the result carefully.
  • Selection under this recruitment does not guarantee employment in J&K Bank after the apprenticeship period ends.
  • Domicile candidates of J&K and Ladakh are eligible for bonus marks and age relaxation in future Banking Associate recruitment, as per the original notification.
  • Keep checking the official website for updates on document verification and further stages.

Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks. However, some sanctioned posts remained vacant because certain selected candidates did not join within the deadline, resigned soon after joining, or were excluded during document verification. To ensure these vacancies are filled, IBPS has released this reserve list for candidates who cleared the exam but were not allotted a bank in the first round.

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026

  2. Click on the "IBPS RRB CRP-CSA (Customer Service Associate)" link on the homepage.
  3. Select "CRP-CRP XIV – Provisional Allotment under Reserve List for CRP-CRP XIV."
  4. Enter your Registration No/Roll No and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the captcha code and click Login.
  6. Check your provisional allotment status and download it for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Candidates provisionally allotted from the reserve list will also receive an intimation email and SMS on their registered contact details.
  • The allotment shown after login is provisional and will be confirmed only after the concerned bank completes document and eligibility verification.
  • Specific documents required for verification are not listed in the official notification. Candidates should follow the instructions issued directly by their allotted bank.
  • Candidates should keep checking their registered email and SMS regularly to avoid missing further communication or deadlines.

What Happens After Reserve List Allotment?

Based on the notification, candidates allotted through the reserve list can expect the following process, though exact dates and requirements are not specified:

  • Document Verification
  • Submission of Required Certificates
  • Medical Examination (if applicable)
  • Joining Formalities
  • Induction/Training Process

Vacancy and Eligibility Details

  • Total Vacancies: 32,679 posts under Constable Civil Police and Equivalent Posts (this notification covers categories such as Civil Police, PAC, and Jail Warder cadres advertised together under Advt. No. 07/2025).
  • Minimum Qualification: Intermediate (12th Pass) from a recognized board or its equivalent.
  • Age Limit: 18 to 25 years, with the cut-off date for age calculation fixed at 01.07.2025. Age relaxation applies as per government rules for reserved categories.

A detailed category-wise (UR/EWS/OBC/SC/ST) breakup of the 32,679 vacancies was not available in the source reviewed for this article. Candidates should check the official detailed notification on uppbpb.gov.in for the exact category-wise and post-wise vacancy split.

DV/PST Shortlisting Cut-Off Marks

UPPRPB shortlisted candidates for DV/PST based on normalized cut-off marks, adjusted for the six shifts in which the written exam was held. The cut-off marks declared are as follows:

  4. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth (or password, if applicable).
  5. Enter the CAPTCHA code shown on screen and submit.
  6. Your admit card will be displayed on screen check your name, roll number, DV/PST date, reporting time, and venue carefully.
  7. Download and take at least two printed copies for the DV/PST day.

The specific document checklist for this DV/PST round is listed in the official DV/PST notice PDFs released by UPPRPB (linked below) and should be verified there, since the exact list can vary by category. Based on past UPPRPB Constable and SI recruitment cycles, candidates are typically asked to carry originals plus self-attested photocopies of documents such as:

  • High School (10th) and Intermediate (12th) mark sheets and certificates

  • Recent passport-size photographs (as specified on the admit card)

  • Keep checking the official UPPRPB website regularly for any updates on DV/PST scheduling or the subsequent Physical Efficiency Test (PET), proposed for September 2026.

What Is the Driving Efficiency Test (DET) in Bihar Police Driver Constable Recruitment?

The DET is a practical driving skill assessment conducted after the Physical Efficiency Test. Candidates who have already cleared the Written Exam and PET are called to demonstrate driving proficiency on a light or heavy motor vehicle, depending on the license category they hold. Only candidates who clear the DET move forward to Document Verification.

Bihar Police Driver Constable Recruitment 2025: Selection Process

  1. Written Examination
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  3. Driving Efficiency Test (DET)
  4. Document Verification
  5. Medical Examination

Candidates have already cleared the Written Examination and PET stages and are now progressing to the Driving Efficiency Test (DET) stage of this recruitment.

How to Download CSBC Bihar Police Driver Constable DET Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official CSBC website at csbc.bihar.gov.in.
  2. On the homepage, click on the "Results / Notifications" section.
  3. Find and click the link for "Driver Constable DET Admit Card 2026."
  4. Log in using your Registration Number / Enrollment Number and Date of Birth.
  5. The admit card will open in PDF format.
  6. Check that your name, roll number, exam date, and exam centre details are correct.
  7. Download the admit card and take at least 2–3 printouts for exam day.

Documents to Carry on DET Exam Day

  • Printed copy of the Bihar Police Driver Constable DET Admit Card 2026
  • Original valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN / Driving License)
  • Original Light Motor Vehicle (LMV) or Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving license, since the DET assesses actual driving skill
  • Passport-size photographs, if specified on the admit card

Candidates without the admit card and a valid photo ID will not be allowed to enter the DET venue.

Important Instructions for CSBC Driver Constable DET 2026

  • Reach the test centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card.
  • Carry your original LMV or HMV driving license along with the admit card.
  • Verify all details on the admit card immediately after downloading; report discrepancies to CSBC through official channels only.
  • Mobile phones and other electronic devices are strictly prohibited inside the test centre.
  • Follow all instructions given by the examination authorities at the venue.

What to Do If the DET Admit Card Is Not Downloading?

  • Confirm that the official website csbc.bihar.gov.in is accessible.
  • Recheck your Registration/Enrollment Number and Date of Birth for entry errors.
  • Clear your browser cache or try a different browser.
  • Download the admit card well ahead of 24 August 2026 to avoid last-minute issues.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

SBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026 - Direct Link, Exam Date & Download Steps

The State Bank of India has released the SBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026 on 30 June 2026 for candidates appearing in the recruitment drive for 7,150 Apprentice posts. Candidates who applied under notification CRPD/APPR/2026-27/07 can now download their hall ticket from the official SBI careers portal using their registration number and password or date of birth. The written examination is expected in the first week of July 2026, with several reports indicating the exam is scheduled around July 11, 2026 candidates should confirm their exact date and shift timing on their individual admit card, as these can vary by exam center.

SBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026 - Overview

This section summarizes the key facts about the SBI Apprentice recruitment and admit card release for quick reference.

Particulars Details
Conducting Body State Bank of India (SBI)
Post Name Apprentice
Notification No. CRPD/APPR/2026-27/07
Total Vacancies 7,150
Admit Card Release Date 30 June 2026
Exam Date First week of July 2026
Selection Process Online Written Test + Local Language Test
Official Website sbi.co.in / sbi.bank.in

SBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026 Download Link

Candidates can use the official login portal to access their call letter. The link below takes you directly to the SBI Apprentice login page where you can enter your credentials and view your hall ticket.

Download SBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026 (Direct Link Active)

How to Download SBI Apprentice Hall Ticket 2026

This section explains the step-by-step process to access and print your SBI Apprentice call letter so you can complete the download without errors.

  1. Visit the official SBI careers website or the direct admit card login link.
  2. Enter your Registration Number and Password (or Date of Birth).
  3. Enter the captcha code shown on screen.
  4. Click on the login/submit button to open your dashboard.
  5. Locate and click the admit card download option.
  6. Save the PDF and take at least two printouts for the exam day.

What's Mentioned on the SBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

The hall ticket works as your identity and entry document for the exam, so every detail on it should be checked carefully against your application.

  • Candidate's name, roll number, and registration number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam center name and complete address
  • Candidate's photograph and signature
  • Gate closing time and exam-day instructions

Documents to Carry to the Exam Center

Along with the admit card, candidates must bring certain documents for verification at the center; missing any of these can lead to denial of entry.

  • Printed copy of the SBI Apprentice admit card 2026 (color or black and white)
  • A valid original photo ID Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, or Passport
  • Two recent passport-size photographs
  • Any additional document specified on the call letter

SBI Apprentice Exam Date 2026

The written examination for SBI Apprentice 2026 is expected to be held in the first week of July 2026, conducted across multiple cities nationwide. The exact date, shift, and reporting time will be specific to each candidate and printed on their individual admit card, so candidates are advised to check their hall ticket carefully rather than relying on a general date. Candidates should also plan to visit their allotted exam center a day in advance to avoid last-minute travel issues.

What to Do If There's an Error on Your Admit Card

Errors such as a wrong name spelling, unclear photo, or mismatched category can create problems during verification at the exam center, so they need prompt correction.

  • Check your name, father's name, and category details for spelling errors
  • Confirm the photograph and signature are clearly visible
  • Contact the SBI helpdesk or recruitment email for any discrepancy
  • Do not wait until exam day report errors as soon as you spot them

RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 - Phase 1 Out, Mains Hall Ticket Expected in July

The Reserve Bank of India has officially released the RBI Grade B Phase 1 Admit Card 2026 on its official portal at rbi.org.in. Candidates who applied for the Grade B Officer (General Cadre) post can download their Phase 1 call letter using their Registration Number and Date of Birth. The Phase 1 exam for the General post was conducted on 13th June 2026, while the Phase 2 Mains exam is scheduled for 25th July 2026 and the Mains admit card is now the next major release that candidates are eagerly waiting for.

This article covers everything you need to know about the RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 from the Phase 1 call letter download process to the expected Mains hall ticket release date, exam shift timings, documents to carry, and exam pattern details.

RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 - Quick Overview

This section gives a snapshot of all key details related to the RBI Grade B 2026 exam and admit card in one place, so candidates can quickly check the current status and upcoming dates.

Particulars Details
Conducting Authority Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
Post Name Officer Grade B - General / DEPR / DSIM
Total Vacancies 60
Phase 1 Exam Date (General) 13th June 2026
Phase 1 Exam Date (DEPR/DSIM) 14th June 2026
Phase 1 Admit Card Release Date 5th June 2026
Phase 1 Admit Card Status Released
Phase 2 (Mains) Exam Date - General 25th July 2026
Phase 2 (Mains) Exam Date - DEPR/DSIM 26th July 2026
Phase 2 Admit Card Status Expected in July 2026
Exam Mode Online (CBT)
Selection Process Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Interview
Official Website rbi.org.in

RBI Grade B Phase 1 Admit Card 2026 - Released

The RBI Grade B Phase 1 call letter was released on 5th June 2026, ahead of the Phase 1 examination held on 13th June 2026. The call letter was made available through the official RBI recruitment portal and candidates were required to log in with their registration credentials to access it. This section also applies to candidates of DEPR and DSIM posts, whose Phase 1 exam was scheduled for 14th June 2026.

The Phase 1 exam is qualifying in nature only scores from this stage are used solely to shortlist candidates for Phase 2 (Mains). Marks from Phase 1 do not contribute to the final merit list.

RBI Grade B Mains Admit Card 2026 - Expected in July

With Phase 1 completed, all attention now turns to the RBI Grade B Phase 2 Mains Admit Card 2026, which is expected to be released in July 2026, ahead of the Mains exam scheduled on 25th July 2026 for General posts and 26th July 2026 for DEPR/DSIM posts. RBI typically releases the Mains hall ticket approximately 7 to 10 days before the exam date, so candidates should watch the official website closely during the second week of July.

The Mains exam is a comprehensive paper that tests a candidate's knowledge of Economic and Social Issues, Finance and Management, and English Writing Skills. Unlike Phase 1, Phase 2 marks are directly counted in the final selection.

 

How to Download RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026

Downloading the RBI Grade B call letter is a straightforward process. The same steps apply for both Phase 1 (already released) and Phase 2 (upcoming). Follow the steps below to access your hall ticket from the official website.

Step 1: Visit the official RBI recruitment portal at https://opportunities.rbi.org.in/

Step 2: Look for the admit card link under the "Call Letter" section select the link for the relevant phase (Phase 1 or Phase 2).

Step 3: A login page will appear on your screen.

Step 4: Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password in the respective fields.

Step 5: Click on the Submit button. Your RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 will be displayed on the screen.

Step 6: Carefully verify all the details printed on the call letter name, roll number, exam centre, and shift timing.

Step 7: Download and take at least 2 printouts to carry on exam day.

Step 8: Read all exam day instructions mentioned on the call letter before the examination.

Details to Verify on Your RBI Grade B Call Letter

After downloading the admit card, candidates must cross-check the following details to ensure everything is accurate. If any discrepancy is found, it must be reported to RBI's recruitment authorities immediately.

The call letter will contain the following information:

Candidate's Name, Roll Number and Registration Number, Photograph and Signature, Date of Birth, Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD), Post Applied For, Exam Date and Shift Timing, Reporting Time and Gate Closing Time, Exam Centre Name, Address, and Code, and Important Exam Day Instructions.

Documents to Carry to the RBI Grade B Exam Centre

Carrying the right documents to the examination centre is mandatory. Entry will not be granted if the candidate fails to produce valid identity proof along with the printed admit card.

Every candidate must bring the following on exam day:

Printed copy of the RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026, 2 recent passport-size photographs, one valid original Photo ID proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence, and a photocopy of the same Photo ID.

PwBD candidates should additionally refer to the Instructions for PwBD Candidates using Scribe and/or Compensatory Time document available on the official website.

RBI Grade B Phase 1 Shift Timing 2026

The Phase 1 exam for General posts was conducted on 13th June 2026 in a single shift. Candidates were required to arrive at the exam centre well before the gate closing time. The general shift schedule for the exam is outlined below.

Exam Phase Reporting Time Gate Closing Time Exam Time
Phase 1 1:00 PM 1:45 PM 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM

Note: Individual admit cards may contain slightly different timings based on centre and shift allocation. Always follow the timing printed on your specific call letter.

RBI Grade B Exam Pattern 2026

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates prepare effectively for both phases of the selection process. The RBI Grade B selection consists of Phase 1 (Prelims), Phase 2 (Mains), and an Interview round.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

Section Questions Marks Duration
Reasoning Ability 60 60 45 Minutes
English Language 30 30 25 Minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 30 30 25 Minutes
General Knowledge (GA) 80 80 25 Minutes
Total 200 200 120 Minutes

Phase 2 (Mains) Exam Pattern - Objective + Descriptive

Phase 2 is the main scoring round with 300 marks spread across 3 papers. Both objective and descriptive components are tested. Marks from this stage directly determine the final merit list.

Paper Subject Question Type Marks Duration
Paper I Economic & Social Issues (ESI) Objective + Descriptive 100 120 Minutes
Paper II English (Writing Skills) Descriptive 100 90 Minutes
Paper III Finance & Management (FM) Objective + Descriptive 100 120 Minutes
Total     300 330 Minutes

RBI Grade B Exam Day Instructions 2026

RBI has issued specific instructions that every candidate must follow on exam day. Non-compliance may result in disqualification from the examination.

Candidates must reach the exam centre before the gate closing time without fail. Biometric verification including thumb impression and photograph capture will be conducted at the centre. Ensure your name on the admit card matches exactly with your photo ID. Wearing clothes with metal items, large buttons, or accessories that could trigger security checks should be avoided. Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

Bank of Baroda has released the Bank of Baroda (BOB) Apprentice Admit Card 2026 for candidates who applied for the 5,000 Apprentice vacancies. The call letter is available on the bank's official career portal, bankofbaroda.bank.in, and candidates can download it by logging in with their registration number and password or date of birth. The online examination is scheduled for June 21, 2026 (Sunday), and the hall ticket is mandatory for entry into the exam centre. Below is everything you need to know the direct download steps, key dates, exam pattern, and what to carry on exam day.

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026: Key Highlights

This section gives a quick snapshot of the most important facts about the BOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026 organisation, posts, dates, and exam mode so you can verify the essentials at a glance before going into the details.

Particulars Details
Organisation Bank of Baroda (BOB)
Post Name Apprentice

Application Last Date 8 June 2026
Admit Card Release Date 19 June 2026

Mode of Exam Online (Computer-Based Test)
Exam Duration 60 minutes

Negative Marking None
Stipend (if selected) ₹15,000 per month during a 1-year apprenticeship

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026 Download Link

Candidates who successfully applied for the BOB Apprentice recruitment between 19 May and 8 June 2026 can now access their admit card online. The hall ticket has been hosted on the official Bank of Baroda careers page, and candidates need their login credentials handy before they try to download it.

  • Official admit card portal: bankofbaroda.bank.in
  • Click Here: Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • Candidates are advised to download and save the admit card well before exam day to avoid last-minute server load or technical glitches.

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Exam Date 2026

This section answers the most commonly searched question when is the BOB Apprentice exam happening. The online test is a single-day, single-shift computer-based exam.

The Bank of Baroda Apprentice Online Examination 2026 is scheduled for June 21, 2026 (Sunday). Candidates should plan their travel to the allotted exam centre in advance and check their reporting time as mentioned on the admit card to avoid last-minute stress.

Credentials Required to Download BOB Apprentice Admit Card

Before logging in to the admit card portal, keep the following details ready. This information is typically the same combination used during registration.

  • Registration Number / Roll Number
  • Password or Date of Birth (as set/used during application)
  • If you have forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" option on the login page to retrieve or reset your credentials.

How to Download Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026

This step-by-step guide explains the exact process to access and download your hall ticket from the official website, so you can complete it without confusion.

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: bankofbaroda.bank.in.
  2. Navigate to the "Careers" or "Current Opportunities" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link that reads "Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026."
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth in the login window.
  5. Click Submit to view your admit card on the screen.
  6. Check all the details carefully and download the admit card.
  7. Take a clear, color printout for use on exam day.

Details Mentioned on the Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card

Once downloaded, candidates should cross-check every detail printed on the hall ticket immediately, since any discrepancy needs to be flagged to the bank well before the exam date.

The admit card typically includes:

  • Candidate's name, photograph, and signature
  • Registration number and roll number
  • Exam date, reporting time, and exam shift timing
  • Complete exam centre name and address
  • Important exam-day instructions and guidelines issued by the bank

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

This section explains how the BOB Apprentice online exam is structured, so candidates know exactly what to expect in terms of sections, marks, and timing.

The BOB Apprentice exam is an online objective-type test consisting of 100 questions for 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes. The paper is divided into four sections of equal weightage, with no sectional time limit unless specified otherwise in the official notification.

Section Number of Questions Marks
General / Financial Awareness 25 25
Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 25 25
Computer Knowledge 25 25
General English 25 25
Total 100 100

Key points about the exam pattern:

  • Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
  • There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
  • No marks are awarded for unattempted questions.
  • The question paper is available in English and Hindi, except for the General English section.

What to Carry on Exam Day

Carrying the right documents is essential, as candidates without a valid admit card or ID proof may be denied entry to the exam centre. This checklist covers what you must bring.

  • A clear, printed copy of the BOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original photo ID proof (such as Aadhaar Card or PAN Card) the same ID used during the application process
  • A recent passport-size photograph
  • Arrive at the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card

What Happens After the Exam?

This section outlines the next stages of the selection process so candidates know what to expect once the online exam is over.

The Bank of Baroda Apprentice selection process does not end with the written exam. Candidates who qualify in the online test move to the following stages:

  1. Document Verification - Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents for eligibility verification.
  2. Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the official local language of the state they applied for.
  3. Medical Examination - A final medical fitness check is conducted before confirmation of selection.

Selected apprentices will be engaged for a one-year apprenticeship period and will receive a stipend of ₹15,000 per month during this engagement.

  • This document is used as a certificate of date of birth and educational qualification.

  • Candidates must provide the account holder’s name, account number, and IFSC code, which are required for fee refund or future payments.

  • Candidates may need to provide a state domicile certificate along with their permanent and correspondence address details, if required.
Other Useful Documents
  • Candidates must keep an active email ID and mobile number, along with the application/confirmation page printout and fee payment receipt, for future reference.

The Karnataka School Education Department (Department of Public Instruction), Government of Karnataka, has released the Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 notification for 15,000 teaching vacancies in government primary and high schools for the 2026-27 academic session. The notification was issued on 12 August 2026, with individual district-wise recruitment notices published through the Karnataka Gazette (e-Rajyapatra) portal between 10 and 12 August 2026, alongside new and amended Karnataka Education Department Services (Department of Public Instruction) Recruitment Rules, 2026.

Quick answer: The Karnataka School Education Department is recruiting for 5 teaching posts - Graduate Primary Teacher (GPT), Assistant Master (AM), Primary School Teacher (PST), Physical Education Teacher (PET), and Computer Science Teacher (CST) - totalling 15,000 vacancies across Karnataka, split between the Kalyana Karnataka region (6,967 posts) and the Non-Kalyana Karnataka region (8,033 posts). Candidates aged 21 to 40 years who meet the post-wise educational and teaching qualifications can apply online from 18 August 2026 to 7 September 2026, with the application fee payable until 10 September 2026. Applications are submitted through the official portal at schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in, and the job location is across government schools in Karnataka.

Karnataka Teacher Vacancy 2026

The Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 covers 15,000 vacancies across five teaching posts. Vacancies are divided between the Kalyana Karnataka region (which follows a separate local-cadre reservation framework under Article 371J) and the Non-Kalyana Karnataka region.

District-wise vacancy notifications are being issued separately by each Educational District through the Karnataka Gazette (e-Rajyapatra) portal; district-wise post numbers are not consistently available at this time and are not included here to avoid presenting unverified figures. Within Kalyana Karnataka, postings additionally follow an 80% Local Cadre (LC) and 20% Remaining Original Cadre (RPC) split as per district-level notices.

Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational and professional teaching qualifications vary by post and subject. Available sources confirm only a general qualification range; exact post-wise and subject-wise qualification requirements are not specified in the notification details currently available and should be confirmed from the official district-wise notification PDF before applying.

Karnataka Teacher Educational Qualification

Candidates should generally have completed 12th/PUC, Diploma, Degree, or Graduation from a recognised board or university, with the specific qualification and subject requirement depending on the post and subject applied for. Not specified in the notification: post-wise minimum qualification (e.g., B.Ed/D.Ed/TET requirements) for each of the five posts.

Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Minimum age: 21 years
  • Maximum age: 40 years (General category)
  • Age relaxation for 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B category candidates: 3 years
  • Age relaxation for SC/ST category candidates: 5 years

The exact cut-off date for age reckoning is not specified in the sources available for this article; candidates should confirm this from the official notification.

Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Salary

As per aggregator-reported figures (not independently confirmed against the primary gazette text for this article), the reported salary range is approximately ₹44,425 to ₹99,400 per month. This figure should be treated as indicative until confirmed from the official notification, as it was available from only one of the sources reviewed.

Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Multiple sources confirm the selection process includes a written examination followed by other prescribed stages. One source additionally describes the process as:

  • Competitive Written Examination (Computer-Based Test)
  • Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test (applicable post-wise, e.g., for Physical Education Teacher)
  • Document Verification

An indicative exam pattern reported by one source (based on earlier similar exams, not confirmed as the official pattern for this cycle) includes questions from General Knowledge, Current Affairs, History & Constitution, and Science, for a total of 100 marks. The same source reports a merit-determination weightage of 85% for marks scored in the competitive examination, 13% for degree/qualifying-exam marks, and 2% for B.Ed marks - this weightage is not confirmed from an official source and should be verified from the notification.

How to Apply for Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official Karnataka School Education Department website at schooleducation.karnataka.gov.in.
  2. Find and click the Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 application link.
  3. Complete the registration using a valid mobile number and email ID.
  4. Log in and fill in personal and educational information.
  5. Upload the required documents, photograph, and signature as per specifications.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee online.
  7. Check all details carefully before final submission.
  8. Submit the application and download the confirmation page.
  9. Keep a printout or soft copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Karnataka Teacher Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates should carefully check post-wise and district-wise eligibility before applying, as requirements vary by post and region.
  • Only online applications are accepted through the official portal.
  • The application fee must be paid by 10 September 2026, even though the application form closes on 7 September 2026.
  • Exam date and admit card release date have not yet been announced; candidates should check the official website regularly for updates.

NTPC Limited, India's largest integrated power utility and a Government of India Enterprise, has released Advertisement No. 10/26 inviting online applications from experienced professionals for the post of Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) in the disciplines of Electrical, Mechanical, and C&I (Control & Instrumentation). NTPC has an installed capacity of over 91 GW and has embarked on an ambitious plan to attain a total installed capacity of 149 GW by 2032.

NTPC is inviting applications for 135 Deputy Manager (E-4 Grade) posts - 40 posts in Electrical, 55 posts in Mechanical, and 40 posts in C&I. These are experienced-professional (lateral) positions requiring a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification executive experience, with an upper age limit of 40 years for all three disciplines. Eligible candidates hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with at least 60% marks. All three posts carry the E-4 Grade/IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 per month. The online application window opens on 12 August 2026 and closes on 26 August 2026. Posting can be at any Station, Project, JV, or Subsidiary of NTPC, and all posts are transferable at the sole discretion of the Management.

How to Apply for NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026

  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute arising from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version will prevail.

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), through the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB), has released the ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Notification on 27 July 2026 on the official website isro.gov.in. A total of 267 (increased) vacancies have been announced for Assistant, Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), Upper Division Clerk (UDC), and Stenographer posts under Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.

Candidates who possess a Graduation with at least 60% marks (or the prescribed Diploma qualification for certain posts) and satisfy the prescribed age limit of up to 28 years (with relaxation for reserved categories as per Government rules) are eligible to apply for these vacancies. The online application process will commence on 27 July 2026 (10:00 AM) and will remain open until 20 August 2026 (11:55 PM).

Candidates can download the ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article. They can also check the detailed eligibility criteria, vacancy details, selection process, application fee, salary, and other important information before submitting their applications.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility

  • Application fee for all posts is ₹100.
  • However, all candidates must initially pay a processing fee of ₹500 per application, uniformly.

Fee is payable only online through the Bharatkosh e-Payment gateway via Internet Banking, UPI, or Debit Cards (domestic). No other mode of payment (cash, cheque, draft, money order, IPO, etc.) is accepted. The processing fee is refunded in full to candidates exempted from the fee (women, SC/ST/PwBD, Ex-Servicemen) who appear in the written test/CBT; for all other candidates, ₹100 is deducted and the balance refunded, provided the candidate appears in the written test/CBT. Refund is not considered if a candidate fails to appear for the written test/CBT.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Written Test

A single objective-type paper of 150 minutes duration (with compensation time for PwBD candidates) will be conducted at 38 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam.

Post Parts Questions / Marks Duration Qualifying Marks
Assistant / UDC (Post 1, 3 & 5) A: General English, B: Quantitative Aptitude, C: General Intelligence & Reasoning, D: General Knowledge 50 Q / 50 Marks each (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)
JPA / Stenographer (Post 2, 4 & 6) A: English Language & Comprehension, B: General Intelligence & Reasoning, C: Quantitative Aptitude & General Knowledge A: 100 Q/100 Marks, B: 50 Q/50 Marks, C: 50 Q/50 Marks (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)

Marking pattern: +1 for correct answer, -0.25 for wrong answer. No TA is paid for attending the written test.

Skill Test

Based on written test performance, candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 (maximum) to the category-wise number of vacancies.

Post Skill Test Components Passing Criteria
Assistant / UDC Computer Literacy Test (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint) 60% (UR), 50% (Reserved categories)
JPA / Stenographer Computer Literacy Test + Stenography Test (300 words @ 60 wpm shorthand, 30 minutes computer transcription) Computer Literacy: 60% (UR) / 50% (Reserved); Stenography: max 10% mistakes (UR) / max 12% mistakes (Reserved)

Final selection is based on marks scored in the written test, from among candidates who qualify in the skill test. In case of a tie, tie-breakers are applied in order: (a) marks in General Intelligence & Reasoning (Post 1,3,5) or English Language & Comprehension (Post 2,4,6); (b) date of birth, with the older candidate preferred.

ISRO ICRB Last Date to Apply Online

  • The online application process for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 started on 27 July 2026 at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 20 August 2026 at 11:55 PM.
  • Candidates who meet the prescribed eligibility criteria are advised to complete the registration process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Applications are accepted online only through the official ISRO website. Applicants should ensure that all required documents, including their photograph, signature, and applicable certificates, are uploaded correctly before submitting the application.
  • The application fee must also be paid online on or before 20 August 2026 for the application to be considered complete.

Direct Link to Apply Online for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted online only, through the ISRO website, between 27-07-2026 (10:00 AM) and 20-08-2026 (11:55 PM).
  • Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to conditions. A candidate may apply for different posts under the same or different zones but cannot apply for the same post in different zones. Candidates applying for multiple posts must select the same written test centre.
  • Email ID and mobile number are mandatory in the online application; all hall tickets, call letters, and communications will be sent only via registered email/SMS, with no hard copies sent separately.
  • Candidates registered under the National Career Services (NCS) portal and meeting eligibility conditions may follow the same application process on the ISRO website.
  • Candidates must upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months, .jpg/.jpeg, 20–50 KB, 200x230 pixels preferred) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, 10–20 KB, 140x60 pixels preferred), along with SC/ST/Disability/Ex-servicemen certificates where applicable.
  • Applications not conforming to the notified requirements, or incomplete applications, will not be considered.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Remuneration

  • Selected candidates will be appointed as Assistant / Junior Personal Assistant / Upper Division Clerk / Stenographer in Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.
  • Minimum basic pay: ₹25,500 per month.
  • Additional allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance as per extant Central Government rules.
  • Employees will be governed by the New Pension Scheme.
  • Other benefits: medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, limited quarters facility (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, and House Building Advance, as admissible per Central Government orders.

Failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.

  • OBC candidates must possess a valid OBC certificate (non-creamy layer, in the prescribed proforma) as on the last date of application. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026–2027.
  • Candidates attending the Skill Test will be reimbursed second-class railway fare (to and fro, shortest route) from the city indicated in the application to the Skill Test venue. No TA is payable for the Written Test.

Objections, with valid justification, may be raised only through the designated link within 5 days of publication; objections received after this window or through any other mode will not be considered.

The number of vacancies indicated is provisional, and ISRO reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill the posts without assigning any reason. The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • Any court case or legal matter arising from this recruitment falls under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised NOT to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO.

The State Bank of India (SBI), Central Recruitment & Promotion Department, Corporate Centre, Mumbai, has released the notification for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026, inviting applications from eligible Indian citizens for the post of Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) in the clerical cadre. The recruitment is published under Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17, and covers 7,680 regular vacancies plus 1,444 backlog vacancies across 24 States/UTs.

Online registration of application and payment of fees runs from 11.08.2026 to 31.08.2026. Candidates can apply for vacancies in one State/UT only and must be proficient in the specified local language of that State/UT. The Preliminary Examination is tentatively scheduled for September 2026, and the Main Examination for November 2026.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (As on 31.12.2026)

Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University, or any equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government. Candidates with an Integrated Dual Degree (IDD) certificate must ensure the date of passing the IDD is on or before 31.12.2026. Candidates in their final year/semester of graduation may also apply provisionally, subject to producing proof of having passed the graduation examination on or before 31.12.2026.

Matriculate Ex-servicemen who have obtained the Indian Army Special Certificate of Education, or the corresponding certificate in the Navy or Air Force, after completing not less than 15 years of service in the Armed Forces of the Union, are also eligible. Such certificates should be dated on or before 31.12.2026.

Age Limit (As on 01.04.2026)

Not below 20 years and not above 28 years - i.e., candidates must have been born not earlier than 02.04.1998 and not later than 01.04.2006 (both days inclusive).

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Reservation

  • 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, for categories including Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, locomotor disabilities (one/both arms, one/both legs, cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, muscular dystrophy, spinal deformity/injury), Autism Spectrum Disorder (mild), intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities.
  • 4.5% of total vacancies are reserved for Disabled Ex-Servicemen and dependents of servicemen killed in action, in addition to the 10% earmarked for Ex-Servicemen (a total of 14.50%). First priority in appointment goes to Disabled Ex-Servicemen, and second priority to dependents of defence personnel killed in action or severely disabled (over 50% disability attributable to defence services).
  • Reservation for PwBD/XS/DXS candidates is horizontal and is included within the vacancies of the various parent categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/GEN) to which the candidate belongs.
  • OBC vacancies are available only to candidates in the "Non-Creamy Layer"; OBC candidates in the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to any OBC relaxation/reservation and must indicate their category as General.
  • Benefit of reservation under the EWS category requires an Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2025-26, valid for 2026-27, issued by a Competent Authority on the Government of India format.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Salary

The pay scale for Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) is Rs. 24,050-1340/3-28,070-1650/3-33,020-2000/4-41,020-2340/7-57,400-4400/1-61,800-2680/1-64,480. The starting Basic Pay is Rs. 26,730 (Rs. 24,050 plus two advance increments admissible to graduates).

The total starting emoluments of a Clerical Cadre employee posted at a Metro like Mumbai will be around Rs. 46,000 per month, inclusive of Dearness Allowance, other allowances at the current rate, and two additional increments for newly recruited graduate Junior Associates. Allowances may vary depending on the place of posting. Selected candidates will be eligible for reimbursement of various perquisites, provident fund, pension under the New Pension Scheme (Defined Contribution Benefit), medical, leave-fare, and other facilities as per Bank instructions issued from time to time.

How to Apply for SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Bank's website, https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings.
  2. Scroll down and click on the relevant advertisement, then download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/2026-27/17.
  3. Register online under "Recruitment of Junior Associates 2026", providing your details in one sitting or saving and resuming (available up to three times before final submission).
  4. Upload your scanned photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified guidelines, and capture a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone.
  5. Pay the requisite application fee online through debit card, credit card, or Internet Banking (fee is Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/XS/DXS, and ₹750 for General/OBC/EWS candidates).
  6. Review your application carefully before final submission - no corrections or edits are allowed after final submission.
  7. Submit the application before the last date, 31.08.2026, and take a printout of the system-generated application form for your own record (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

For any problem in filling up the form, payment of fee, or receipt of admission/call letter, candidates may contact the helpdesk at 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM on Bank working days) or lodge a query at http://cgrs.ibps.in, mentioning 'Recruitment of Junior Associate-2026' in the subject line.

SBI Junior Associate Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained, and the fee paid for other registrations will be forfeited.
  • Request for change or correction of any particulars, including category, once the application is submitted, will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute connectivity issues; SBI will not be responsible for failure to submit an application due to heavy website traffic or reasons beyond its control.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, smart watches, calculators, or any other communication/electronic devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • The Bank may capture thumb impressions or IRIS scans at various stages for biometric verification; any inconsistency may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or misbehaviour during the examination may be disqualified, debarred from future Bank examinations, and held liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No hard copy of the call letter (Preliminary/Main) or the "Acquaint Yourself" booklet will be sent by post; candidates must download these from the Bank's website.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and satisfactory completion of Know Your Employee (KYE) formalities, as well as the Bank's service and conduct rules.

DGQA Technician Selection Process 2026

Selection is done through a Written Test followed by a Trade Test - there is no interview.

  • Written Test: Objective type, Multiple Choice Questions only; no negative marking for wrong answers; duration 90 minutes; 100 questions for 100 marks.
Part Subject Questions Marks
(i) General Intelligence and Reasoning 25 25
(ii) General Awareness 25 25
(iii) English Language and Comprehension 25 25
(iv) Numerical Aptitude 25 25
- Total 100 100

Question papers for Parts (i), (ii), and (iv) are set in English and Hindi; Part (iii) is in English only. Candidates are shortlisted for the Trade Test based on written test marks and category of reservation. The Trade Test carries 100 marks, with a minimum qualifying mark of 40. The final merit list is prepared post both tests, based on Trade and Establishment. In case of a tie, resolution is by (1) older date of birth ranked higher, then (2) higher marks in Numerical Aptitude, then Reasoning, then General Awareness.

How to Apply for DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026

DGQA Technician Recruitment 2026 has no apply-online option. The application must be sent physically by Registered or Speed Post only.

  1. Fill the application in the prescribed format (Appendix 'A'), typed in English on A4 size paper.
  2. Attach the Admit Card in the prescribed format - Appendix 'B' for Technician (Semi Skilled) or Appendix 'C' for Technician (Skilled) - submitted in duplicate.
  3. Affix one self-attested passport-size photo on the application form, and one self-attested photo on each of the two admit card copies (three photos total).
  4. Enclose a self-addressed envelope (30cm x 12cm) affixed with a postal stamp of Rs. 55/- for admit card despatch.
  5. Clearly superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Technician (Semi Skilled) / Technician (Skilled)] AND CATEGORY [SC/ST/OBC/UR]".
  6. Candidates already working in Government Service or a Public Sector Undertaking must route their application through proper channel, with a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office; applications without this NOC are summarily rejected without further communication.
  7. Send the complete application by Registered/Speed Post to: Controllerate of Quality Assurance (Systems), DGQA Technical Complex, Manovikas Nagar P.O., Secunderabad – 500009.

Applications received after the closing date, even due to postal delay, are rejected summarily and no correspondence is entertained.

NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a subsidiary of NTPC Limited, has released Advertisement No. 03/26 inviting applications from experienced professionals for Manager (E-4 Grade) posts across its Renewable Energy (RE), Finance and Land verticals. NGEL, the commonly used short form for NTPC Green Energy Limited, has a presence in the renewable power and hydrogen generation business and has embarked on a plan to attain a total installed capacity of 60 GW by 2032. As an equal opportunity employer, NGEL is hiring for its Corporate offices, Stations, Sites, Clusters, JVs and subsidiaries across India.

NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL) is inviting applications for 34 Manager (E-4 Grade) posts - 28 posts of Manager – RE, 5 posts of Manager – Finance, and 1 post of Manager – Land. These are experienced-professional (lateral) positions requiring a minimum of 10 years of post-qualification executive experience, with an upper age limit of 40 years for all three posts. Eligible candidates include Engineering graduates (for Manager – RE), CA/CMA-qualified professionals (for Manager – Finance), and postgraduates in specified social/rural management disciplines, MSW, MBA, or Engineering graduates (for Manager – Land). All posts carry the E-4 Grade/IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000–200,000 (w.e.f. 01.01.2017). The online application window is open from 11 August 2026 (10:00 Hrs) to 31 August 2026 (18:00 Hrs), and there is no offline application mode. Postings can be at any Corporate Centre, Site, Station, Project, JV, or Subsidiary of NGEL across India.

The role mainly involves sourcing new customers, expanding the branch portfolio, identifying potential business locations, supporting customer onboarding, and collecting installments from customers on scheduled dates.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Vacancy 2026

NABFINS has announced an opportunity for the post of Customer Service Officer. The CSO works closely with the branch team and plays an important role in customer sourcing, portfolio growth, verification, field operations, disbursement support and recovery.

The number of vacancies has not been specified in the details provided for this recruitment.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role

The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch.

The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include:

  • Sourcing of clients.
  • Primary verification of client credentials.
  • Conducting Compulsory Group Training.
  • Data entry in CRIF.
  • Data entry in CMS.
  • Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test.
  • Accompanying CSE during pre-disbursement activities.
  • Ensuring disbursement.
  • Generating demand.
  • Following up for recovery and undertaking collections.
  • Remitting collections in the bank or banks.
  • Reporting demand and collection details to ABM/BM.
  • Maintaining and filing documents.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Location

  • Bihar
  • West Bengal
  • Tamil Nadu
  • Chhattisgarh
  • Gujarat
  • Uttar Pradesh

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 must meet the prescribed educational, language and field mobility requirements.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Qualification

The minimum educational qualification is:

PUC/10+2 completed.

Candidates who have completed Higher Secondary or an equivalent 10+2 qualification can apply, subject to the other eligibility requirements.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Language Requirement

Applicants must have written, spoken and reading command over the local language and English.

This requirement is important because the role involves regular interaction with customers, branch staff and field-level operations.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Experience

Freshers are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer post.

However, candidates with 1 to 3 years of experience in a similar job profile and sufficient exposure to field operations and the target customer population may be preferred.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Driving Licence Requirement

A valid driving licence and motorcycle are mandatory for the Customer Service Officer role.

The job involves field visits, identifying new business locations, customer sourcing, collection and other branch-related field activities.

NABFINS Lead Auditor Qualification

The Auditor shall provide Independent, objective assurance and consulting services to add value and improve organization’s operations. Conduct regular audit of the branches as assigned by the Asst. Manager/ Manager/ Senior Manager. Submit the audit reports on timely basis.

The detailed selection process has not been specified in the information provided.

Candidates who submit their resume may be shortlisted by NABFINS based on eligibility, educational qualification, experience, field suitability and other requirements of the Customer Service Officer role.

Shortlisted candidates should follow further instructions communicated by NABFINS regarding the next stages of recruitment.

How to Apply for NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026?

Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 by sending their updated resume to the official recruitment email address.

  1. Check the NABFINS Customer Service Officer eligibility criteria.
  2. Prepare an updated resume containing educational qualification and work experience details.
  3. Ensure that your mobile number and email address are correctly mentioned in the resume.
  4. Attach the updated resume to the email.
  5. Use a clear subject line such as Application for Customer Service Officer (CSO).
  6. Send the application to [email protected].
  7. Complete the application process on or before 18 August 2026.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.
