Himachal Pradesh High Court Various Post Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Qualification
Court Manager (Group -B)
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree in any discipline along with an MBA from a UGC-recognized university/institution in India. Candidates must also have 3 years of experience in Process Management, IT Systems Management, Human Resources Management, or Financial Management. Knowledge of Legal Affairs and Computer Applications is desirable.
Clerk (Group-C)
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a recognized university and basic computer knowledge, including operating Windows/Linux, typing, and taking printouts. Candidates must qualify the Screening Test, Written Test, Typing Test, and Document Verification. The typing test requires a speed of 30 WPM in English and 25 WPM in Hindi on a computer using Kruti Dev-10 font.
Stenographer Grade-III (Group-C)
  • Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a recognized university. They must qualify the Screening Test, followed by a Stenography Test with a speed of 80 WPM in English and a Typing Test with a speed of 40 WPM in English and 30 WPM in Hindi using Kruti Dev-10 font. A maximum of 10% mistakes is allowed in both stenography transcription and typing; candidates exceeding this limit will be disqualified.
Driver (Group-C)
  • Candidates must have passed Matriculation (10th) from a recognized board. They must possess a valid LMV driving license for at least 3 years and have at least 3 years of experience in driving LMVs. Selection will be based on the Screening Test, Driving Proficiency Test, and Document Verification. Good mechanical knowledge of automobiles will be preferred.
Process Server (Group-D)
  • Candidates must have passed the 10+2 (Senior Secondary) Examination from a recognized board. Selection will be based on the Screening Test, Written Test, and Evaluation as per Part 10 of Schedule-III of the R&P Rules, 2022.
Peon, Orderly, Chowkidar,  Safai Karamchari & other Group-D Posts
  • Candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination from a recognized board. Candidates will be shortlisted in a 1:3 ratio for Evaluation/Document Verification based on 10+2 marks (85 marks) and evaluation of uploaded documents (15 marks). The final merit list will be prepared based on educational qualification and evaluation marks. Candidates may be posted to any of the applied posts by the appointing authority in the Civil & Sessions Division.

Also Read: Coal India Limited MT Exam Date 2026

How to Raise an Objection on RPSC JLO Answer Key 2026

RPSC has released a separate Press Note on 10/08/2026 covering the online objection process for Paper-I, II, III, and IV. The exact objection window (opening and closing dates) and the per-question fee were not confirmed in the source material used for this article candidates must check the official Press Note on rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in for these specifics. Based on RPSC's general practice in other recent 2026 examinations, the process typically follows this pattern:

  1. Log in to the Rajasthan SSO Portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) using your SSO ID and password.
  2. Open the Recruitment Portal and select the "Question Objection" link for the Junior Legal Officer (JDA) Exam - 2025.
  3. Select the paper and the question serial number exactly as printed on the Model Question Paper.
  4. Upload authentic supporting proof, such as scanned pages from standard reference books, to justify the objection.
  5. Pay the prescribed objection fee per question (typically ₹100 per question in recent RPSC exams not confirmed specifically for this exam; verify on the official portal).
  6. Submit the objection and save the acknowledgement receipt for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • The Model Answer Key is provisional. It is subject to change based on valid objections received from candidates.
  • Objections must be submitted strictly against the question serial number as it appears on the official Model Question Paper, not on an individual candidate's personal question booklet series.
  • Objections submitted without documentary evidence or after the objection window closes will not be considered.
  • The Final Answer Key will be published only after RPSC reviews all objections received during the window.
  • The written examination result and subsequent merit list will be prepared based on the Final Answer Key, not the provisional one.

Also Read: IBPS PO MT XVI PET Admit Card 2026

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes

Once the objection window closes, RPSC will examine all objections received. Where an objection is found valid, the Commission will revise the provisional answer key accordingly and publish the Final Answer Key. The Junior Legal Officer (JDA) written exam result will be declared based on the Final Answer Key, after which candidates who qualify will be shortlisted for the next stage of the selection process as specified in the official recruitment notification.

What Is a "Final" Answer Key?

RPSC typically issues answer keys in two stages:

  • Provisional/Model Answer Key  released first, open to candidate objections within a specified window (usually with a per-question objection fee).
  • Final Answer Key  released after RPSC reviews all valid objections. This is the answer key used for actual evaluation and scoring. No further objections are accepted once the final key is published.

The Gastroenterology (SS) and Medical Oncology (SS) documents released on 10 August 2026 are Final Answer Keys, meaning they represent RPSC's confirmed, evaluation-ready responses for these two subjects.

Visit the official CGPSC website to check the answer key, estimate your score, and complete the objection process within the deadline.

Download CGPSC Assistant Librarian Model Answer Key 2026

How to Raise an Online Objection Against the Answer Key

Candidates can follow these steps to submit an objection through the CGPSC website:

  1. Visit the official CGPSC website and log in to the candidate dashboard.
  2. Go to the Activity Section and click on Objection Filing.
  3. On the new page, select the exam name, question paper, set, and the question number you want to object to.
  4. Select the applicable type of objection (see list below).
  5. Clearly write the reason for the objection in the box provided.
  6. Upload supporting proof as a PDF document (maximum size 1MB per question). Proof must include the source name, author, edition/publication date, and reference page number — mere links or website names without this detail will not be accepted.
  7. Use the Add button to submit multiple objections; unwanted entries can be removed before final submission.
  8. Click Save after entering all objections.
  9. Proceed to the fee payment page and click Pay Now to pay Rs. 50 per question for all objections raised.
  10. After successful payment, download the acknowledgement/receipt from the Dashboard under Activity Section > Download Acknowledgement.

Types of Objections Accepted

Objection Type Description
All Answer Options Incorrect All given options for a question are wrong
Commission's Answer Option Incorrect The answer option released by the commission is wrong
More Than One Correct Option More than one answer option is correct
Question is Wrong The question itself is incorrect
Question Out of Syllabus The question is not part of the prescribed syllabus
Hindi-English Translation Mismatch There is a factual difference between the Hindi and English translation of the question

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections can be submitted only through the online mode; no offline application or document will be accepted at the commission office.
  • Candidates get only one opportunity to submit all objections together; once the fee is paid, the process is considered complete and objections cannot be filed again.
  • Candidates are responsible for avoiding phishing, hacking, or other cyber risks during online banking/payment.
  • If the fee payment is unsuccessful, if entries are made in different sets of the same question paper, or if the prescribed process is not followed correctly, the submitted objection will be automatically rejected, and no request/appeal regarding this will be entertained by the commission.

  4. Select the question number you want to challenge and mark your proposed answer.
  5. Upload supporting documentary proof (standard textbook reference in PDF format).

Once the objection period ends, RPSC will review all valid challenges through its subject expert panel. Based on this review, the Commission will release the final answer key. The final result and merit list will be prepared strictly using the final answer key, not the provisional one. Any objection submitted without valid supporting documents is typically not considered.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

The ISS Examination 2026 Statistics papers for which the provisional answer key has been released are:

  • Statistics Paper I - Covers topics such as Probability, Statistical Methods, Numerical Analysis, and related areas.
  • Statistics Paper II - Covers topics including Linear Models, Statistical Inference, Sampling Theory, and Econometrics.

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

Key Skills
MultitaskingProblem SolvingClient RelationshipEnglish Proficiency (Spoken)English Proficiency (Written)AdaptabilitySales
Role Snapshot
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store. Key responsibilities: A. Customer focus: 1. Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up. 2. He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers. 3. He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively. 4. He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has. B. Product recommendation: 1. With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales. 2. He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions. C. Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence: 1. Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently. 2. Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage. D. Store upkeep & maintenance: 1. He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly. 2. He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store. Note: This role requires working 6 days a week with a rotational week-off and rotational shifts based on business requirements. Please note that there are no night shifts. Training information: Candidates selected for the role after successfully completing the interview process will be attending a one month mandatory offline training program at a designated Lenskart Academy, which is an integral part of the onboarding process. Performance-based incentives will be provided

The nature of this job requires daily interactions with internal and external stakeholders.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensures safe operation of all electrical equipment in the kitchen venues and laundry rooms.
  • Performs maintenance on electrical vehicles, e-trams, and e-bikes, heavy machinery, and boats.
  • Understands the CCTV/Data System and fixes the issues.
  • Performs Fire Alarm System inspections and maintenance.
  • Inspects and ensures the Audio & Video System (Videlio) are in working condition.
  • Sets up and maintains the satellite dish system and TV units in the accommodation, offices, and venues.
  • Ensures the weather stations antenna is in working condition for daily operation.
  • Assists Supervisor to work on high voltage equipment.
  • Follows safety protocols while working with electrical equipment, ensuring the own safety and safety of others.
  • Demonstrate a safety-first culture and follows the Companyâs policies and procedures.
  • Determines the suitability and appropriateness of all electrical equipment newly acquired or in operation.
  • Understands how to use electrical system documentation such as drawings, service, and instruction manuals.
  • Determines if all components and parts used in the electrical systems are covered by the AMOS maintenance jobs and advises the Electronic Manager of any discrepancies.
  • Responds to, diagnoses, and fixes electrical issues. Applies safety regulations and safety practices at all times.
  • Reads work orders, maintains records of daily tasks, and discusses challenges with the Electronic Manager.
  • Ensure that all electrical spare parts are available in ample quantity to perform the job safely.
  • Uses clear, concise, and professional communication in person, over the radio, and in written format.
  • Demonstrates effective teamwork and collaboration, and time management skills.
  • Maintains an orderly and clean work area, with all tools in good repair.
  • Adheres to all Company policies regarding PPE and Chemical Management.
  • Sets up and closes working areas as per schedule or as instructed by the Management Team.
  • Participates in trainings and meetings. Adheres to a Company confidentiality agreement.
  • Follows the destinationâs grooming standards. Ensures personal appearance, hygiene, and uniform appearance are always in accordance with Company policy. Maintains a safe and sanitary environment for Guests and the Team.
  • Acknowledges and greets Guests, visitors, and Team Members in public spaces with a warm, friendly greeting.


Financial Responsibilities

  • Maintains the inventory of tools and equipment.
  • Determines inventory and compiles a bi-weekly list of all supplies/tools needed.


Qualifications:

  • A High School Diploma or basic education equivalency.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressive technical experience and training in a resort or marine environment.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of operational experience with electrical equipment, including power generation, sewage treatment plants, incinerators, potable water production, satellite communications, and operating equipment.
  • Advanced knowledge of electrical systems, needs assessment, problem resolution, and quality standards.
  • Valid license or certificate(s) in the area of technical specialty are required.
  • Good interpersonal skills to communicate with all levels of Management and Team Members.
  • Ability to work positively and cooperatively in a diverse international environment.
  • Ability to maintain focus, work with strict deadlines, multitask and be flexible and adaptable.


Language Requirements:

  • Ability to speak English clearly, distinctly, and cordially with Guests, Team Members, Contractors, and Vendors.
  • Ability to read and write English, to understand and interpret written procedures. This includes the ability to give and receive instructions in written and verbal forms and to effectively present information and respond to questions from Guests, Managers, and Team Members.


Physical Requirements:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to touch, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste and smell. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • All destination Team Members must be physically able to participate in emergency life-saving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal, and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency.


Work Environment:

  • Destination outdoor environment where high temperature, precipitation, and humid temperatures are experienced.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is required to work outdoors in extremely humid and hot conditions for an extended period of time.

This is a position where duties are exercised outdoors, walking in sand, and uneven surfaces, and high scaffolding.
